codeReview.summary: Clean, well-implemented additive feature. Two new named exports (setLightPalette, setDarkPalette) added to theme.js, each delegating to the existing validatePalette() helper, setting DOM attributes on documentElement, and persisting to localStorage. Invalid inputs gracefully fall back to 'github'. 18 unit tests provide thorough coverage of valid palettes, invalid inputs (null, undefined, empty string, wrong-type), DOM attribute updates, and localStorage persistence. No existing functions were modified — this is a pure additive change.

summary: The feature fully satisfies VAL-UNIT-001 and all expectedBehavior items from the feature spec. Implementation is concise (22 lines), well-documented with JSDoc, and reuses the existing validatePalette() helper — no duplication. The 18 new tests cover all required scenarios (valid palettes, invalid inputs, DOM updates, localStorage persistence) with symmetric coverage for both setLightPalette and setDarkPalette. The worker followed the refactoring-worker skill's TDD procedure (Red → Green → Lint → Commit). All 44 tests pass, lint is clean (0 errors). No existing behavior was changed. Status: pass.
